enabled.description: Register the timing-scrambler stage (default true). Its enforce/audit/off mode is the mediator's stages["egress-timing-scrambler"] entry.

minDelayMs.description: Shortest random delay added before each outbound send (default 0 ms, range 0-600000). maxDelayMs - minDelayMs must be at least 750 ms.

maxDelayMs.description: Longest random delay (default 750 ms, range 750-600000; maxDelayMs - minDelayMs must be at least 750 ms). The delay is drawn uniformly from the cryptographic RNG; a wider range removes more of a timing signal at more latency.
